scope: Canonical custom armor and weapon projects across Steven’s local Hytale sessions
sourcePriority: Current canonical360-no-scope modules; source specs plus current generated language names. Historical ranger-snipers and360-arsenal overlap and are not extra equipment.

armorSets.name: Vestments of the Pale Rider
armorSets.theme: An original Hytale homage to Death and his Reaper transformation in Darksiders II, guided by Steven's supplied image.

pieces.name: Death's Veil
pieces.lore: Beneath this ragged midnight cowl, a pale mask keeps its final vigil. Its hollow gaze recalls the Horseman who walked beyond the grave and returned with the silence of kingdoms.

pieces.name: Mantle of the Reaper
pieces.lore: A cage of ancient ribs rises into the broken wings of a deathless reaper. Verdigris iron and funerary bronze bind its spectral heart; the living hear a heartbeat where no heart remains.

pieces.name: Harvester's Grasp
pieces.lore: These burial-bound gauntlets close with the certainty of a final breath. Bone knuckles cradle the haft of the Harbinger, lending flesh and sorcery to the work of the Pale Rider.

pieces.name: Pale Rider's Strides
pieces.lore: Tattered funeral cloth trails behind greaves that have crossed the Dead Kingdom without leaving a footprint. Every measured step carries their wearer closer to the next soul's appointed hour.

armorSets.name: Vestments of the Crimson Brotherhood
armorSets.theme: Original Hytale Brotherhood assassin armor matching The Diddlers: graphite leather, blackened angular metal, crimson cloth, talon engravings and ruby fittings. Comparable craft and progression grade to Vestments of the Pale Rider.

pieces.name: Cowl of the Crimson Oath
pieces.lore: A narrow crimson seam watches from beneath this midnight hood. Its angular mask bears the Brotherhood's first vow: speak no name before the work is done. Blackened fittings honor the cruel elegance of the Daedric Princes; the face behind them belongs only to the oath.

pieces.name: Shroud of the Unseen Hand
pieces.lore: Graphite plates overlap a heart of crimson cloth, each talon-shaped seam bound by a different broken promise. A faceted blood-red stone seals the covenant at the breast. The Brotherhood calls it a shroud because its wearer has already surrendered the life that came before.

pieces.name: Grasp of the Last Whisper
pieces.lore: Recessed crimson channels trace these articulated gauntlets like the patient venom in the Brotherhood's twin daggers. Stitched leather closes beneath forged knuckle plates. Their fingers remember the final words of every oathbreaker; their keeper never repeats them.

pieces.name: Strides of the Dread Stalker
pieces.lore: Layered greaves carry the same hooked lines as the daggers sworn beside them. Dark leather, inset rubies and a divided crimson hem mark the Brotherhood's hunters. Beyond the gates of Oblivion, even the longest road is measured one condemned step at a time.

armorSets.name: Vestments of the Black Tempest
armorSets.theme: Original dark-side-influenced Hytale storm-mage armor: charcoal hood and divided robes, blackened obsidian plates, storm-violet and blue recessed channels, restrained pale-violet cores. Designed around AB's Tickle Time without copying a licensed character's armor.

pieces.name: Cowl of the Storm Tyrant
pieces.lore: The first tyrant begged the heavens for mercy. The second learned to command them. Beneath this blackened crown, a violet gaze keeps the final lesson: a storm has no conscience, and neither should the hand that guides it.

pieces.name: Mantle of Black Dominion
pieces.lore: Obsidian ribs close around a heart of captive thunder. Every channel beneath this mantle was etched with a surrendered name; every pale flash is a promise that its owner will never again kneel. The storm does not lend its strength. It collects what it is owed.

pieces.name: Strides of the Hollow Tempest
pieces.lore: These divided robes have crossed battlefields where the rain fell upward and no witness kept their shadow. Dark plates conceal the price of each measured step: another breath stolen from the world, another moment granted to its unrepentant master.

companionHands.name: AB's Tickle Time
companionHands.note: Reuse the original Legendary Hands item and its exact saved enchantments, durability, attacks, glow and appearance. This addon grants +6 native Haste only to an eligible primary Mage wearing the unbroken original in Hands. It does not grant attack-speed acceleration, unlock a full-set multiplier or impose a class gate on the existing gauntlets.

weapons.name: Harbinger of the Pale Rider
weapons.lore: A crescent of blackened mithril carries the skulls of those who bargained with the last Horseman. Their silent mouths drink the final warmth from every wound and return it as power to the hand that reaps. Death does not hurry. His tithe always comes due.
weapons.visual: Original black-mithril crescent with three-dimensional embedded skulls, beveled faces on both sides, bone collars, violet wraps and mint soul channels.

weapons.name: The Diddlers
weapons.lore: Forged in reverence to the Daedric Princes, these twin fangs carry a whisper from beyond the gates of Oblivion. Every crimson arc writes another blasphemy into living flesh; every wound deepens a patient venom. Their maker prayed for mercy. Something answered.

weapons.name: AB's Tickle Time
weapons.lore: Mercy was the first thing these gauntlets burned away. Their black hearts do not summon the storm: they teach it whom to hate. Spread your fingers, drain the strength from your own flesh, and let ten little promises of agony crawl beneath your enemy's skin. The first crack is thunder. What follows is their understanding. AB called it Tickle Time. Nobody laughed twice.

weapons.currentDescription:

weapons.name: Gobliterator's Requiem
weapons.lore: Recovered from the wreck of the Gobliterator, this rifle carries a heart that has forgotten how to stop. Deepworks artificers meant its rail chamber to shatter gates. A patient marksman taught it a quieter purpose. Amber coils kindle around a cyan rail, the scope settles, and the stolen core begins its last hymn. Then comes a single iron verdict, followed by a long, rattling breath while the chamber cools. The last sound of the Deepworks belongs to whoever holds this weapon.

weapons.name: Dawnpiercer, Last Light of Luminia
weapons.lore: Three shattered seals sleep within a lattice of Prisma. When their fragments align, white-gold runes awaken along the stock and a violet star gathers behind the lens. Luminian wardens are said to have carried such lights when the sanctums fell silent, saving each brilliant shot for the shape at the far end of the dark. This remnant answers the same oath: hold fast, choose the moment, and let a single ray speak. Between shots, its crystal hums like dawn remembered beneath stone.
